digest.component_or_area: gate workflow step and review kernel
propositions: Dead code computing severity_label(imp) at decide.py:681-684 is discarded and should be removed
Gate policies still reference unwired fail_on_severity keys in steps.py that conflict with ADR 0108's priority_threshold mechanism
REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH environment variable in gate_ops.py controls an A/B test (a9dd) that is finished and the flag should be removed
Schema files reference severity field in findings that should be replaced with priority as the canonical gate decision criterion
Test coverage for severity-driven gate failures must be rewritten to use priority-based equivalents
